newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa cancels Tirana flight on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa cancels Tirana flight on Friday.

text.p: Deutsche Lufthansa AG said it has cancelled its March 14 flight to Albania because of the closure of Tirana airport.
The Albanian airport was closed traffic on Thursday as unrest spread to the area around the airport, airline officials said.
A Lufthansa spokesman told Reuters: "We are following developments very closely and will decide in the next few days how to proceed."
Lufthansa had no plans at present to suspend flights indefinitely, he added.
Lufthansa currently flies from Frankfurt to Tirana on Mondays, Wednesdays, Fridays and Saturdays with a Boeing 737 aircraft.
Austrian Airlines said earlier it was cancelling flights to Tirana until further notice.
